items.prompt: Where should I leave the shipment documents?
choices: In the tray by Ms. Park's office.
items.note: Where 問地點。(B) 答的是時間；(C) 用 Yes 回答 WH 問句一定錯，還重複了 shipment→shipped。

items.prompt: Where's the nearest print shop?
choices: There's one across from the bank.
items.note: (B) 重複 print 的變化形，是最常見的陷阱；(C) 答價錢。

items.prompt: Where did the marketing team hold their meeting?
items.note: (B) 答時間、(C) 答人，都是「答錯疑問詞」。

items.prompt: Where can I find the employee handbook?
choices: It's posted on the company intranet.
items.note: (B) 重複 find→found；(C) 答的是「誰會拿到」不是「在哪裡」。

items.prompt: Where are we sending the invoices this month?
choices: Directly to the client's accounting department.
items.note: (B) Yes ＋ 重複 send；(C) Because 是回答 Why 的。

items.prompt: When does the training session start?
items.note: (B) 答地點；(C) Yes 回 WH 問句。

items.prompt: When will the renovation be finished?
choices: Not until the end of March.
The contractor did a great job.
items.note: Not until... 是回答 When 的常見句型，要聽得出來它其實在講時間。

items.prompt: When did you last update the client database?
items.note: (B) 答頻率，那是 How often 的答案 —— When 和 How often 混淆是高頻失分點。

items.prompt: When are the quarterly results being announced?
choices: They've been pushed back to next Tuesday.
items.note: (B) 重複 results；(C) 答地點。

items.prompt: When should we order more toner?
choices: As soon as we're down to two boxes.
From the supplier on Fifth Street.
items.note: (A) 用條件句回答時間，不給明確鐘點 —— 這是進階但常考的形式。(C) 重複 order。

items.prompt: Who's covering the front desk this afternoon?
items.note: (B) 用 cover 的另一個意思（涵蓋）當陷阱；(C) 答時間。

items.prompt: Who approved this budget increase?
items.note: (B) 答數量；(C) Yes ＋ 重複 increase。

items.prompt: Who do I talk to about parking permits?
choices: Try the facilities office on level one.
I parked in the visitor lot.
items.note: (A) 回答的是「部門」不是人名 —— Who 的答案不一定是人名，這點要習慣。

items.prompt: Who's giving the presentation tomorrow?
choices: Ms. Delgado, unless her flight is delayed.
items.note: (C) 重複 give→gave，而且有 She 讓你誤以為在講人。

items.prompt: What time does the store close on Sundays?
choices: Six, I think, but let me check.
items.note: What time 就是問 When。(B) 重複 close→closed。

items.prompt: What did you think of the new supplier's quote?
choices: Honestly, it seemed a little high.
I quoted him the same price.
items.note: What did you think of...? 是問意見。(B) 重複 quote；(C) Yes ＋ supplier→supply。

items.prompt: What's the problem with the projector?
items.note: (C) 重複 problem 而且用 No 開頭 —— 聽起來很順但完全沒回答。

items.prompt: What should I wear to the client dinner?
choices: At seven, at the Italian place.
items.note: (B) 答時間地點；(C) 重複 wear→wore。

items.prompt: What's included in the maintenance contract?
choices: Repairs and two inspections a year.
items.note: (C) Yes 回 WH ＋ 重複 include。

items.prompt: Why was the shipment delayed?
choices: There was a problem at customs.
items.note: (B) 答方式，那是 How 的答案；(C) Yes ＋ 重複 delayed。

items.prompt: Why isn't Daniel at the staff meeting?
choices: He's out at a client site today.
items.note: 否定疑問 Why isn't...? 照樣當 Why 回答，不要被 isn't 影響。

items.prompt: Why did they change the office layout?
choices: To make room for the new hires.
items.note: (A) 用 To＋原形 表目的，是 Why 的標準答案之一。(C) change 當「零錢」的同字陷阱。

items.prompt: Why are the printers being replaced?
items.note: Why 的答案不一定有 Because，直接講原因就夠了。

items.prompt: How long will the interview take?
items.note: How long 問時間長度，不是問「多長的東西」。(C) 重複 interview。

items.prompt: How did the product launch go?
items.note: How did...go? 是問「結果如何」不是問方法。(C) By train 是 How 的另一種答案，專門騙這個。

items.prompt: How many people are coming to the workshop?
items.note: (B) 也有數字（three-hour）但答的是長度不是人數 —— 有數字不代表是答案。

items.prompt: How do I submit an expense report?
choices: Through the portal, I'll send you the link.
items.note: (B) 重複 submit 且答時間；(C) 答金額。

items.prompt: How often does the cleaning crew come?
choices: Three times a week, in the evenings.
items.note: How often 問頻率，答案是「幾次／多久一次」。(C) Yes ＋ 重複 clean。

items.prompt: Have you seen the revised floor plan yet?
choices: No, could you forward it to me?
items.note: (B) 重複 floor、(C) 重複 plan —— 兩個陷阱夾攻，正解反而是最樸素的那個。

items.prompt: Did the technician fix the air conditioning?
choices: He's coming back tomorrow with a part.
items.note: ★ 間接回答：沒說 Yes/No，但「明天帶零件再來」等於還沒修好。多益最愛考這種，別因為沒聽到 Yes/No 就排除。

items.prompt: Is this seat taken?
items.note: (B) 重複 take→took。free 在這裡是「空著」不是「免費」。

items.prompt: Are we still meeting the deadline?
items.note: meet the deadline ＝ 趕上期限。(B)(C) 都把 meet 當「開會／見面」來騙你。

items.prompt: Do you know if the caterer has been confirmed?
items.note: ★ 間接回答：講「某人早上處理掉了」＝ 已經確認。(B) 有 Yes 但後半接不上。

items.prompt: Has the new intern started yet?
items.note: (A) 用 begin 換掉 start，這是正解常見的做法 —— 正解通常換字，陷阱才重複原字。

items.prompt: Was the budget proposal approved?
items.note: ★「還在等消息」是合法的迴避型答案。(B) 重複 proposal→proposed。

items.prompt: The copier is jammed again.
items.note: 直述句要聽「對方在暗示什麼」—— 抱怨機器壞了，合理回應是去處理它。

items.prompt: I can't find my badge anywhere.
choices: Security can issue a temporary one.
items.note: 對方有困難時，正解通常是「提供解法」。(C) 重複 find→found。

items.prompt: This report has to go out before five.
choices: Then I'd better start on it now.
items.note: Then... 開頭的回應在直述句題型很常見。(B) 重複 go→went。

items.prompt: We're running low on printer paper.
choices: There's another case in the storeroom.
items.note: run low on ＝ 快用完了。(B) 把 run 當「跑步」，是典型的片語拆解陷阱。

items.prompt: The client just moved our meeting to Thursday.
choices: That actually works better for me.
They moved into a new building.
items.note: (B) move 換成「搬家」的意思來騙。work 在這裡是「時間方便」。

items.prompt: I thought the workshop was cancelled.
choices: No, they just changed the room.
items.note: 「我以為…」是在確認資訊，正解通常糾正它。(B) 用 workshop 裡的 work 做近音陷阱。

items.prompt: Someone left an umbrella in the lobby.
choices: Put it in the lost and found.
items.note: (C) 跟雨傘有關聯所以特別危險 —— 話題相關不等於回答了對方。(B) 重複 leave。

items.prompt: You've worked with this vendor before, haven't you?
choices: Yes, on two projects last year.
items.note: 附加問句就當一般 Yes/No 問句回答，haven't you 不用另外處理。

items.prompt: The training is mandatory, isn't it?
choices: For anyone in a client-facing role, yes.
items.note: (A) 先加條件再說 yes，順序跟中文直覺相反，要聽完整句。

items.prompt: You didn't order the extra chairs, did you?
choices: I did, actually. They arrive Monday.
items.note: ★ 否定附加問句：對方猜「你沒訂」，而你訂了，就要用 I did 反駁。(C) 的 No 順著對方講但後半矛盾。

items.prompt: Should I email the file or bring you a printout?
items.note: ★ 選擇疑問句不能用 Yes/No 回答，聽到 or 就可以先刪掉所有 Yes/No 開頭的選項。

items.prompt: Do you want to take the train or drive?
items.note: ★ Whichever／Either／It doesn't matter 這類「都可以」是選擇疑問句的高頻正解。

items.prompt: Is the presentation this morning or this afternoon?
items.note: ★ 第三選項陷阱：正解兩個都不選，直接給你第三種情況。這題型很常出現。

items.prompt: Could you take a look at these figures before I send them?
items.note: Could you...? 是請求，答案是答應或婉拒。(B)(C) 各重複一個原句單字。

items.prompt: Would you like me to book a taxi for you?
choices: That would be a big help, thanks.
items.note: Would you like me to...? 是「我幫你做…好嗎」的提議。(B) 把 book 當名詞「書」，同字不同詞性的陷阱。
